description: Call this after you edit code, before saying it works. Finds the workflows your change touches (uncommitted edits included) and runs this repository's real code against digital twins of the services they call, with production failures injected: a reply lost after the write, a 500, a slow reply, a duplicate webhook. Returns pass or fail, each problem with file and line, cost per incident and a fix, and what to do next. Nothing reaches the real services.

base.description: Branch or commit to compare against (default: the merge base with the default branch).

name: check_change
